aboutGame.title: What is Sort of Magic?
paragraphs: Sort of Magic is a cozy magic-themed sorting puzzle game where every stage is built from tubes of colored liquid. You move the top segment of one tube onto a matching color or an empty tube until each stack holds a single color, turning a messy board into a clean, ordered shelf.

The campaign spreads that core rule across escalating level tiers, while the daily challenge adds fresh boards, streak bonuses, and reward tiers on a fixed schedule. Sort of Magic supports solo play and online co-op for up to four players, so you can plan a board alone or work through it with friends.

modules.name: Sort of Magic Beginner Guide
modules.description: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of the core sorting loop, how pouring works, and the habits that help new players clear their first levels.

highlights.detail: Scan the whole board first and note which colors are already stacked together.
Start with the tubes that hold the fewest colors, because they finish the fastest.
Pour only onto a matching top color or an empty tube; every other move is rejected.
Keep one tube empty for as long as you can, since it is your working space.
Undo a pour the moment it buries a color you still need further down.
Finish each tube one color at a time and use the daily challenge to practice harder boards.

modules.name: Sort of Magic Multiplayer Guide
modules.description: Co-op tips for splitting a board, coordinating pours, and clearing levels together with up to four players.

highlights.detail: Set up a shared session so each player works a different section of the board.
Call out the color you need before you pour, so teammates leave a matching top.
Reserve one empty tube for the player handling the hardest stack.
Pause before using a booster so nobody wastes it on a board a teammate can clear.
Review the cleared board together and plan the next level before restarting.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Sort of Magic.

items.question: What is Sort of Magic?
items.answer: Sort of Magic is a cozy magic-themed sorting puzzle game. Each level gives you a set of tubes filled with colored segments, and you pour the top color onto a matching stack or an empty tube until every tube holds a single color.

items.question: How do you play Sort of Magic?
items.answer: Read the whole board first, keep one tube empty as working space, and only pour a color onto a matching top or an empty tube. Sort of Magic rewards planning over speed.

items.question: Does Sort of Magic have a daily challenge?
items.answer: Yes. The Sort of Magic daily challenge refreshes on a fixed schedule, scales to your progress, and rewards streak bonuses for clearing it day after day.

items.question: How many levels does Sort of Magic have?
items.answer: Sort of Magic is built around level tiers that climb toward a level 100 milestone, with each tier introducing a new twist on the sorting rules.

items.question: Can you play Sort of Magic in co-op?
items.answer: Sort of Magic supports solo play and online co-op for up to four players, so you can split a board with friends or clear it on your own.
